evals.prompt: Find dead clicks on our homepage. We don't have session replay.
evals.expected_output: Runs or describes a scripted tap test on a phone viewport over up to 3 pages, uses 3 tries in fresh pages before calling a tap dead, sorts each into fix or restyle, and names the top one with a file.
assertions: Requires repeated tries before calling a tap dead
Sorts each into make-it-work or stop-looking-clickable
Names the top fix with a file or selector

evals.prompt: Hotjar shows lots of rage clicks on our pricing toggle. What now?
evals.expected_output: Reproduces the toggle on a phone, checks whether it responds slowly or not at all, looks for an overlay or a handler error, and gives one fix with the file.
assertions: Checks for slow response versus no response
Gives one fix tied to a file or handler
